name: FEEDBACK_LOOP_OUTCOME_CHAIN_20261107
comment: DEGRADED: 0 outcomes fed, 1057/1057 alert scores 0.00, 8300 orphan chains, and maria promoted to
proposal_allowed with 506 resolved and 0 graded. Root cause, measured read-only on 2026-11-07:
(1) the chain matcher ignored paper_trades.proposal_id and took the first same-symbol/strategy
trade after the proposal — 966 of 1458 chains named ANOTHER proposal's trade, 114 closable chains
stayed `linked`, 8 read `closed` for a trade now cancelled/dedup_removed, and ORDER BY created_at
DESC LIMIT 100 starved 1644 eligible June-August proposals forever;
(2) alert scoring wrote action_taken=false / score 0.00 for the 14 notification types that have no
rule at all, and both of its sources are dead (john_decision_queue: 0 rows ever; agent_feedback_log:
last row 2026-07-18), so 1057 rows assert John ignored alerts nobody could answer;
(3) agent_calibration_engine counted `neutral` (a hold or a rejected proposal) as `resolved`, so a
flood of holds earned a tier with no graded evidence.
The gate pins: an outcome is the proposal's own FK trade; pnl_pct is the trade's own, never pnl/100;
a flat pnl is NEUTRAL not WRONG; a chain that stops being closed becomes feedable again; the backlog
drains oldest-first; an unmeasurable alert is NULL with a named reason while a live source's zero is
kept; a measured alert row is never overwritten; and a calibration tier is earned on
Hermetic: scripted cursors and pure functions. No DB, no network.
